map.药品近效期自动预警提醒 使用指南: Near-Expiry Drug Automatic Alert Reminder User Guide
map.记录药品名称、批号与有效期，自动计算剩余天数并按效期排序，用绿、黄、橙、红颜色分: Record the drug name, batch number and expiry, compute the days remaining automatically and sort by expiry, with green, yellow, orange and red graded alerts so expired drugs are never used.
map.家庭药箱或诊所药房录入药品名称、规格、批号与有效期，按剩余天数自动分级预警。: Enter the drug name, specification, batch number and expiry in a household medicine box or clinic pharmacy, and it grades the alert automatically by days remaining.
map.按批号管理同类药品，做到近效期先出先用，减少过期浪费。: Manage the same drug by batch number and use first-expiry-first-out to cut waste.
map.定期导出清单核对实物，清理已过期药品并补充常用药。: Export the list regularly to check against the physical stock, clear out expired drugs and restock the common ones.
map.：剩余天数 = floor((有效期 − 今天) ÷ 86400000)，两端均: Days remaining = floor((expiry − today) ÷ 86400000), subtracting after both sides are reset to midnight of the day to avoid half-day errors. Grades: <0 days expired (red); ≤30 days urgent (orange); ≤90 days note (yellow); ≤180 days watch (yellow); >180 days safe (green). The list is sorted ascending by days remaining so the nearest is first, and you can filter by status and count each status.
map.：以 2026-09-10 为基准：某药品有效期 2026-10-01，剩余 2: Taking 2026-09-10 as the baseline: a drug expiring 2026-10-01 has 21 days left → "urgent", use it first or replace it soon; another batch expiring 2026-12-31 has 112 days left → "note", it can circulate normally but should go into next quarter's first-out plan; anything expiring before 2026-09-10 is shown as "expired", must be withdrawn immediately and recycled as required, and must not be taken.

map.过了有效期一天的药还能吃吗？: Can I still take a medicine that expired a day ago?
map.不建议。有效期是生产企业在规定贮存条件下对含量与安全性负责的截止日，过期后有效成: Not recommended. The expiry date is the date up to which the manufacturer takes responsibility for potency and safety under stated storage conditions; after that the active ingredients may degrade and impurities increase. Drugs sensitive to potency such as insulin, nitroglycerin, adrenaline and antibiotics may fail to work once expired. No visible change does not mean the potency is still adequate, and expired drugs should be recycled as required rather than taken.
map.为什么按批号而不是按药名管理？: Why manage by batch number rather than by drug name?
map.同一药名的不同批次有效期不同，只记药名会把近效期与远期批次混在一起，失去预警意义: Different batches of the same drug have different expiry dates, and recording only the drug name mixes near-expiry batches with long-dated ones, which defeats the alert. Registering by batch number and using "first out, first expired" sharply reduces waste; dispensing and use should also follow first in first out, and the batch and expiry information should be kept after splitting a pack.
